subject.title: fix(feishu): upgrade single newlines to double newlines for post+md rendering

question: Which Feishu newline PR should be the canonical landing path for the open post-md rendering bug?
rationale: Several branches target the same bug; the strongest proof-positive candidate is currently dirty, while this branch is proof-blocked and still has a known rendering defect.

options.title: Rebase/adopt the proof-positive branch
options.body: Resolve the conflict on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99394 and use it as the canonical branch if the maintainer accepts its formatting and fanout behavior changes.

options.title: Continue this branch
options.body: Ask this contributor to fix the mixed-block and length/fanout hazards and attach redacted live Feishu proof before another review.

options.title: Pick another candidate
options.body: Choose another open Feishu newline PR only if it becomes proof-positive, cleanly mergeable, and covers the same send/edit/reply hazards.

recommendation.title: Rebase/adopt the proof-positive branch
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99394 and use it as the canonical branch if the maintainer accepts its formatting and fanout behavior changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names this handle as the community maintainer for the affected channel.
